notes.title: Devlog v0.3.15
notes.content:
We missed posting some of our past devlogs here on Steam — so now we’re catching up! Each week, we’ll share another devlog from the previous months until we’re up to date with the latest one. This way, you can see the full journey of Space Tournament so far. 🚀

[b][/b]
[h2][b]🚀 Steam Deck Support[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] The on-screen keyboard now opens automatically when text fields are selected.
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]🔗 Steam Integration[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Steam usernames are now used as player names as default.
[*] Steam friends are automatically added to the in-game friends list.
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix issue with focus in Popups.
[*] Add missing parallax effect in the main menu.
[*] Editor: Fix crash when deleting pressed with an uninitialized tile selected.
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]🎮 User Interface (UI)[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Renamed "Syncing" with more meaningful Strings.
[*] Placeholder text now shown if an input icon is missing.
[*] Added an award list to the in game overlay.
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]🔊 Gameplay Experience[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added sound effect for the spaceship's tractor beam.
[/list]

notes.title: Devlog v0.3.14
notes.content: We missed posting some of our past devlogs here on Steam — so now we’re catching up! Each week, we’ll share another devlog from the previous months until we’re up to date with the latest one. This way, you can see the full journey of Space Tournament so far. 🚀 [b][/b] [h2][b]🖥️ System[/b][/h2] [list] [*] Updated to [b]Godot Engine 4.4[/b]. [/list] [b][/b] [h2][b]✨ Features[/b][/h2] [list] [*] Added [b]DestroyableGenerator[/b] — a destructible map tile. [*] Players can now select a [b]custom color[/b] for their player label. [*] Added [b]Playtest invite link[/b] from the demo version. [*] New music tracks: Safe Zone and Space Attack by Josh Kashdan. [*] If a player is too slow, the game now explains the [b]required time[/b] to complete the level. [*] Background and foreground elements are now [b]blurred and darkened[/b] for improved focus. [*] Editor: Improved the [b]Colorize[/b] function and made it [b]removable[/b]. [*] Added in-game access to the [b]bug report[/b] feature. [/list] [b][/b] [h2][b]⚙️ Settings[/b][/h2] [list] [*] Added [b]keybinding customization[/b] for keyboard controls. [*] Added [b]rebindable controller inputs[/b] with sensible defaults. [*] New setting: [b]Enable/Disable V-Sync[/b]. [/list] [b][/b] [h2][b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b][/h2] [list] [*] Fixed: TriggerLoop was triggering one extra time. [*] Fixed crash when attempting to disband a group without selecting one. [*] Fixed: Editor mouse cursor would switch to [b]scale mode[/b] and not revert. [/list]

notes.title: Devlog v0.3.13
notes.content:
We missed posting some of our past devlogs here on Steam — so now we’re catching up! Each week, we’ll share another devlog from the previous months until we’re up to date with the latest one. This way, you can see the full journey of Space Tournament so far. 🚀

[b][/b]
[h2][b]🛠️ Editor Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added folder management buttons and improved the tile property system.
[*] Enhanced controller support with tooltips and a [b]Joywheel[/b].
[*] Improved validation for tile properties and menu entries.
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]📹 Replays & Mission Runs[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Replays are now automatically created and stored on the server.
[*] Improved validation and integrity checks for MissionRuns.
[*] Added a [b]global ranking tab[/b] and replay filtering.
[*] New settings: [b]Auto-save successful & failed replays[/b].
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]🚪 RigidBody2D Doors[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Doors converted to RigidBody2D for physics-based interaction.
[*] Improved collision handling and [b]damage mechanics[/b] for crushing objects.
[*] Fixed [b]lighting and sound effects[/b] related to door interaction.
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]🎮 User Interface (UI)[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a [b]new in-game menu[/b] and [b]video mode settings[/b].
[*] Improved [b]Big UI Mode[/b] compatibility.
[*] Introduced [b]hierarchical back navigation[/b] instead of browser-style back.
[*] Added configurable [b]in-game camera zoom[/b].
[*] Various [b]translation updates[/b] and UI bug fixes.
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]🚀 Gameplay & Features[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added [b]GoldOre Collector[/b] and finalized spaceship stats.
[*] Removed [b]credit system[/b] and [b]campaign history system[/b], keeping only high scores.
[*] Adjusted [b]campaign unlocks and awards[/b].
[*] Enhanced [b]tractor beam visuals[/b] and [b]hull colorization shaders[/b].
[*] New [b]high-score challenge[/b] for levels up to [b]Chapter 8[/b].
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]🗺️ Mission Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Welcoming Mission[/b]: Gates now open when taking off.
[*] Improved [b]goal mechanics[/b] and [b]gate indicators[/b].
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with [b]cannon shots passing through objects[/b], trophy timing, UI inconsistencies, and ship layout saving.
[*] Improved [b]pause menu behavior[/b], component purchases, and background layer positioning.
[*] Fixed [b]garage ship preview[/b], engine fire flickering, fuel refill menu, and ranking display.
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Space Tournament Playtest
notes.content:
[h1]Attention Pilots![/h1]

We're thrilled to invite you to the first playtest of Space Tournament, running until April 30th. This is your exclusive opportunity to experience high-speed, zero-gravity racing and showcase your piloting prowess.

[b]Why Join the Playtest?[/b]

- [b]Early Access[/b]: Be among the first to navigate through asteroid fields, dodge laser grids, and outmaneuver opponents in intense space races.

- [b]Shape the Game[/b]: Your feedback is invaluable in refining the gameplay and ensuring an exhilarating experience for all.

- [b]Global Competition[/b]: Compete against pilots worldwide and aim for the top spot on the leaderboard.

[u][b]How to Participate:[/b][/u]

1. Sign Up: Visit our official website to register for the playtest.

2. Download the Game: Upon registration, you'll receive a link to download the playtest version.

3. Start Racing: Strap in, hit the thrusters, and immerse yourself in the cosmic chaos.

Don't miss this chance to be part of the Space Tournament's inaugural playtest. The playtest concludes on April 30th, so enlist now and claim your place among the stars!

Sign Up Here: [url=https://forms.gle/STwh3HD9F4wmSTAd8] Space Tournament Playtest Registration[/url]

We can't wait to see you drift through the cosmos and make your mark in the galaxy.

[previewyoutube=1IpI-HEizjE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]See you in space, pilot![/b]
